root_causes.evidence: Network p95 is 2010ms against a 29.8ms baseline, with a 6% error rate. Clearing logs show repeated network_send_failed timeouts while item 95 stays pending. The clearing queue depth is 136.

escalation.reason: Clearing is healthy but the external payment network is timing out (p95 ~2s against a 30ms baseline, 6% errors), so item 95 only waits and is not poison; this is an external outage that needs escalation.
escalation.ask: The national payment network is timing out: p95 is about 2s against a 30ms baseline, with 6% errors. Posted payments are piling up in the clearing queue (depth 136). Please contact the network operator to restore service. Clearing will drain the queue on its own once the network recovers. Do not quarantine or reverse any payments.

sbar.situation: Recovery is not confirmed: the national payment network is down and payments are not clearing. At the last check (69 s, 4 looks) clearing had 667 items waiting, oldest 77 s, with 0 processed per second and 100% of calls to the network failing.
sbar.background: The network's p95 latency rose to 2010 ms against a 29.8 ms baseline, with a 6% error rate. Clearing logs show repeated network_send_failed timeouts, and item 95 has stayed pending after 34 attempts.
sbar.assessment: The root cause is an external outage of the national payment network (confidence 0.85). Gateway, payments, screening and ledger are healthy, and balances match the ledger. The incident commander took no repair action itself, because the fault is outside our systems; it escalated the outage to the network operator.
sbar.recommendation: Follow up with the network operator, who was asked to restore service, and watch for clearing to drain the backlog on its own once the network recovers. Do not quarantine or reverse any pending payments. Operations should review the delayed settlement of the queued payments, now 667 items.
